description: Fault fixtures used by `npm run validate` and reproducible by hand (see docs/OPERATIONS.md).

scenarios.name: later-batch-service-down
steps: POST /ops/advance            -> batch 1 (currency) effective
POST /ops/pause
stop service report-format   (only batch 3 needs it)
POST /ops/advance            -> 409 paused (no silent advance while paused)
POST /ops/resume
POST /ops/advance            -> batch 2 (search) effective despite report-format down
start service report-format

scenarios.name: coordinator-crash
steps: kill -9 coordinator
start coordinator            -> GET /admin/state?detail=1 shows recovered=true
POST /ops/advance            -> continues from actual batch progress

scenarios.name: coordinator-crash-mid-switch
steps: POST /ops/advance?fault=committed  -> process exits after entries committed, before bookkeeping
start coordinator            -> successor re-reads entries, adopts the committed epoch
GET /admin/state?detail=1    -> batch effective, no duplicate work

scenarios.name: rollback-with-inflight
steps: POST /accept (currency) x N  -> accepted under current version, long delay
POST /ops/pause
POST /ops/rollback
POST /ops/rollback/confirm   -> succeeds while requests still executing
GET /requests/:id            -> in-flight requests still return the version pinned at acceptance

scenarios.name: service-restart-recovery
steps: POST /accept (currency)      -> request enters a delayed segment
kill -9 <service>
start <service>              -> boot heals journaled pending units
GET /requests/:id            -> result matches the version pinned at acceptance

scenarios.name: entry-crash-cross-entry-retry
steps: POST entry-a /accept         -> accepted and running
kill -9 entry-a
POST entry-b /retry {requestId} -> resumes from the shared ledger with the pinned version
GET entry-b /requests/:id    -> correct result, retries >= 1

scenarios.name: progress-live-while-running
steps: POST entry-a /accept (currency) -> fx-tag delays ~500ms
GET /admin/records?ids=<id> -> each route segment listed separately
-> finished segments show serviceCompleted + entryReceipt
-> not-yet-run segments show explicit gaps, actualVersion=null

scenarios.name: progress-withheld-receipt-then-restart
steps: POST /admin/progress/control {entry_receipt:true} -> hold receipt evidence (execution unaffected)
POST entry-a /accept (currency)    -> service completions visible, receipts withheld
stop entry-a and fx-tag            -> GET /admin/records still shows progress + actual version, receipt 'not observed'
restart fx-tag and entry-a, POST /admin/progress/control {entry_receipt:false}
GET /admin/records?ids=<id>        -> buffered completion and receipt evidence backfilled

scenarios.name: progress-path-outage-duplicates-late
steps: POST /admin/progress/control {service_done:true} -> interrupt the progress path
POST entry-c /accept + wait done   -> business result correct; /admin/records marks the gap
POST /admin/progress/control {service_done:false} -> buffered evidence drains, gap closes
replay/late events to /admin/progress -> no segment duplicated, no version/state rewind
